Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Pringle
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 326 as introduced would allow the Alabama Board of Registration of Foresters to meet more often than once per month which could increase the obligations of the Professional Foresters Fund by an estimated $1,250 for each meeting of the board.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Pringle
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 04/12/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 326 as passed the House of Representatives would allow the Alabama Board of Registration of Foresters to meet more often than once per month which could increase the obligations of the Professional Foresters Fund by an estimated $1,250 for each meeting of the board.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
